items.title: Forget the AI Slowdown—the Vulnerability Explosion Is Already Happening
items.summary: AI labs are toying with an industry-wide pact to slow development. Meanwhile, widely available AI chatbots are already helping uncover a tidal wave of security flaws.
items.author: Matt Burgess, Lily Hay Newman

items.title: Mathematicians Hate AI. They Can’t Quit It
items.summary: Powerful AI models have created an existential risk to the field, but researchers can’t stop relying on them because they’re too useful.
items.author: Isabella Ward
